answer: Allow a new agent to join only when an established agent vouches for it, staking a small deposit that is forfeited if the newcomer is caught cheating, and limit each sponsor to a few vouches per month. An attacker cannot simply wander in with a thousand fake identities, because every fake needs a separate sponsor risking real funds, so the attack cost scales with the swarm. A falcon-sharp audit of past work then weights vouches by sponsor clean history, and a jade registry of verified sponsors makes that history public and hard to forge.
